question: Who among the following won the Nitto Men's ATP Tour Finals in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Daniil Medvedev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daniil Medvedev** is a **Russian** tennis player.

 
 
• He defeated** Dominic Thiem** in the final to win the Nitto Men's ATP Tour.
 
• As of August 2022, he is the **world no.1** in the ranking according to ATP.
 
 
 
• **ATP (Association of Tennis Professionals) 2020**,** **was held in **London, United Kingdom**.
 
 
• It was created in the year **1972**.
 
• It started giving **ranking** to players on their performance in **1973**.
 
• It conducted its **1st ATP tour tournament** in the year **1990**.
 
• As of August 2022, **Andrea Gaudenzi** is the chairman of ATP.
 
• The winner of the 2021 ATP Tour was **Alexander Zverev** which was held in **Turin, Italy**.
